clue.text: Song about Ross Poldark initially being a surly fellow

taken as written

indicators.note: signals that only the opening letter of Poldark is used

explanation.surface: A song about the brooding Cornish hero Ross Poldark, who is a famously moody character.
explanation.definitionFit: A grumpy, bad-tempered person is called by this informal word for an irritable grouch.

clue.text: Hat on European's head

explanation.walkthrough: 'head' looks like part of the picture but is the definition, a headland; the 's is a link meaning 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A headland jutting into the sea is called a cape, as with Cape Horn.

clue.text: Paints family in fisherman's clothing

parts.note: oils are paints used by artists
kin means one's relatives

explanation.surface: A family of painters wearing the waterproofs of fishermen.
explanation.definitionFit: A waterproof coat of oiled cloth is the classic garment worn by sea fishermen.

clue.text: Bear trainers will get equipment for emergencies

pumps are light canvas sports shoes, a British word for plimsolls or trainers

explanation.definitionFit: These tubes are used in hospitals to empty the gut after poisoning or overdose.

clue.text: Graduate's upset with marks, refuses a drink

stains are marks or blemishes

explanation.surface: A graduate, upset at their marks, turns down a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who declines alcohol or goes without is said to hold back from it.

clue.text: Tool that man's taken into small room that's unfinished

explanation.definitionFit: A woodworker's or sculptor's bladed cutting implement is a classic example of a hand tool.

clue.text: Prevent trophies being sent back

indicators.note: signals the trophies word is read backwards

parts.note: pots is slang for trophies or cups won in sport

explanation.surface: Preventing trophies from being returned.
explanation.definitionFit: To halt or block something from happening is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Corrupt senator betraying country

indicators.note: corrupt suggests the letters of senator are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A corrupt politician is betraying his country.
explanation.definitionFit: The crime of disloyalty to one's own state is its legal name; betraying country is the act itself.

clue.text: Jocular remark having drunk ales in storeroom

explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' rearranges the beer to LEAS, set just after the storeroom's first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A light joke or polite bit of banter is a well-known sense of this word.

clue.text: Tablet with primrose that's got rid of cold — you'll sleep on it

clue.text: Yield of grain reported

parts.note: a seed is a grain, as of corn

explanation.definitionFit: To give up or surrender territory or a point is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Favour including location of Villa's museum piece

explanation.walkthrough: ASTON sits within ROSETT_E. Aston Villa is an English football club in Birmingham.
explanation.definitionFit: The inscribed stele that unlocked hieroglyphs is a celebrated exhibit in the British Museum.

clue.text: Vegetable that's acceptable uncooked mostly

parts.note: OK means acceptable or all right

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word, so its last letter goes

parts.note: raw means uncooked

clue.text: See a lush reeling round old pubs

a drunk reels, so these letters stagger into a new order

clue.text: Captivated in spring time — contrariwise

a bound is a spring or leap

explanation.surface: Someone enchanted in springtime, or so it seems the other way round.
explanation.definitionFit: Held enthralled as if by magic is the sense of this adjective.

clue.text: Liking a swan song

parts.note: a pen is a female swan
a chant is a simple song

explanation.surface: A fondness for the swan song, the last performance before death.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong fondness or taste for something is the meaning of this French-derived word.

clue.text: Quaker founding US state concerned with flag

parts.note: William Penn, a Quaker, founded Pennsylvania
on means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A Quaker founding an American state concerned with designing its flag.
explanation.definitionFit: A long tapering streamer flown from a lance or masthead is this kind of flag.

clue.text: Causing panic in the manner of king on film

parts.note: a la, from French, means in the style of

a mist is a thin film, as on glass

explanation.surface: A scene causing panic, done in the style of a king on screen.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something that spreads needless fear is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Show sullen face about a second-grade work

indicators.note: the frowning word goes around the other letters

parts.note: to lour is to frown or look sullen

explanation.surface: A pupil scowling over a B grade for their work.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard toil or effort is a direct synonym for work.

clue.text: Mistake put British Library in inferior position

parts.note: BL is the abbreviation for the British Library
under means beneath or in a lower position

explanation.surface: It was a mistake to put the British Library somewhere lower down.
explanation.definitionFit: A clumsy, careless error is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Veteran sundial maybe

a sundial is an ancient device for telling time, jokingly an aged timekeeper

explanation.surface: An experienced old hand, perhaps a sundial.
explanation.definitionFit: An old hand with long experience is so called, and a sundial is literally an ancient timekeeping device.

clue.text: Drive round Northern Ireland track

indicators.note: the driving word goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: to motor is to drive

explanation.surface: A driver going round a racetrack in Northern Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'track' looks like a racecourse but is the verb, to keep watch on.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep watch on or follow progress is the verbal sense shared by both words.

clue.text: Greek goddess took meal including chicken

a hen is a chicken

clue.text: Author, 'On the Beach'?

what lies on the shore, fine grains of eroded rock

clue.text: Fraternal author of tales mostly gloomy

clue.text: Language of Jaipur dude

clue.text: Rescue vehicle perhaps transported the police by river

explanation.definitionFit: A rotorcraft used for air-sea rescue is one example of a rescue vehicle.

clue.text: Prepare line for fish

parts.note: to do a dish or room is to prepare it
RY is short for railway, a railway line

explanation.surface: Getting a fishing line ready to catch a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The John Dory is an edible sea fish, and the word names it.

clue.text: Herded by police, odd one that's given a beating
